text.tspan: “Mistress Creola, I think I get it. I know how to add with 3,”
Ameer knew a lot and was a little disappointed for not
volunteering like Maida. He liked how brave she was.
“Yes, please come show us,” said Mistress Creola.
“First, I position my junior counter to 3 then more 1 bead
Maida continued, “Then I first position to 1, then add more
When Maida got to her seat, she opened her lunch box to
sure she had her sandwich, again.
